periods.time: Seven Stars opening day at Hagun hospital
periods.label: 彼方守候刀华

status.current: safe after Akatsuki's Fantasy Form attack and watching over Toka

relationships.toka-todo: Student council president; Kanata is at her bedside when she wakes.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Student council vice president still asleep nearby.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Asks Toka to compare Ikki and Moroboshi during the broadcast.

periods.summary: Kanata sits beside Toka in the hospital room when Toka wakes from the Akatsuki attack. She explains that Hagun's students survived because the damage was in Fantasy Form, and she watches the Seven Stars broadcast with Toka, prompting Toka's analysis of Ikki's match against Moroboshi.

key_events.summary: Explains the post-attack situation to Toka while watching the broadcast.
